_comment: Copy to aply-config.json to change delivery. Without that file the sandbox and dev run in TEST mode: a swipe right delivers the application to the simulated inbox at /outbox and nothing leaves this computer. In live mode a swipe right emails the recruiter by itself after grace_seconds (Undo cancels it); set auto_send to false to show a Send button instead. Only postings that list a recruiting email can be emailed; the rest hand off to the employer's own page. test_recipient sends EVERY live application to that address instead of the recruiter, so you can test real email safely. Never commit real credentials.

smtp.password: a Gmail app password (not your normal password)
